summary.text: Democrat Amanda López Askin won the election for New Mexico Secretary of State on November 3, 2026, defeating Ramona Goolsby, according to unofficial results, and is set to take office when the new term begins.
She has been Doña Ana County Clerk since 2018 and said her experience running 12 elections in the state's second most populous county qualified her.

paragraphs.text: López Askin holds a master's degree in marriage and family therapy and a Ph.D. in educational leadership from New Mexico State University.
Doña Ana County commissioners appointed her county clerk two months before the 2018 midterms, and she won re-election in 2020 and 2024.
She won the June 2026 Democratic primary for Secretary of State over Santa Fe County Clerk Katharine E. Clark.
She won the November 3, 2026 general election for Secretary of State of New Mexico with 60.9% of the vote to Ramona Goolsby's 39.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
